narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Unfolding
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple geopolitical fronts escalate simultaneously: US-Iran kinetic exchange, Israel two-front war, and Ukraine deep strikes into Russia. The EIA's Hormuz blockade timeline through 2027 and the Apache shootdown confirm the conflict is broadening, not de-escalating.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and emerging market equities; overweight defense stocks.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Bites Structurally
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists, with Kuwait seeking pipeline bypasses and EIA raising WTI forecasts to $88.32. The structural disruption to oil supply is now priced in, but any diplomatic resolution could reverse flows quickly.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; short consumer discretionary and airlines; consider long volatility on oil options.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Accelerates
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's risk-off selloff, capital is flowing into crypto infrastructure as Janus Henderson partners with Ethena for tokenized CLOs, signaling institutional DeFi breakthrough. This is a structural trend separate from macro risk-off, with whales accumulating and retail dip-buying.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC on dips; long ETH and select DeFi tokens like ENA; short-term hedge with put spreads on BTC due to macro headwinds.
